description: Sends a brief to Formada3D (info@formada3d.com) for a custom design or manual quote, with the person's name and email so we can reply (within 1 business day). Requires user_confirmed=true, meaning the person asked for it and agreed to share those details. Rate-limited; no files are stored (pass a link to the file).

description.description: What they need: purpose, sizes, load, quantity, colour, deadline (20-4000 chars).

file_url.description: Optional link to a file/photo/sketch (we do not download or store it here).

user_confirmed.description: Must be true: the person asked for this enquiry to be sent and agreed to share these details.
